name: Mama to no Ikisugi Ama Ama Seikatsu ~Ippai Kimochi Ii Koto Oshiete A-Ge-Ru~
original_name: ママとのイキすぎ甘々性活～いっぱい気持ちいいコト教えてあ・げ・る～
source:
"Enough already!"

Hitoshi has decided to leave his mother.
Ignoring the pain in his heart, he speaks clearly to his mother, Rinko.
But Rinko doesn't understand.

Hitoshi is going through a rebellious phase because he isn't being pampered enough.
Rinko concludes this and her pampering escalates.
